description: Ship at minimum two fixture Go modules under `bas/fixtures/` (`go-cycles/` and `go-mislocated/`) each with hand-curated `expected-graph.json`. CI fails if any fixture's extracted graph diverges byte-for-byte from the expected file. This is the trust anchor for every consumer.

requirements.description: Ship at minimum two fixture Go modules under bas/fixtures/: go-cycles/ (a module with intentional import cycles) and go-mislocated/ (a module with mislocated files). Each fixture must include hand-curated expected-graph.json files that represent the canonical expected extraction output. CI must run extraction against each fixture and fail the build if the extracted graph differs byte-for-byte from the expected-graph.json. This gate is the trust anchor for all downstream consumers and must not be skipped or soft-failed.
requirements.title: Golden-Fixture Determinism CI Gate with Curated Expected Graphs

validation.notes: Test the fixture comparison utility: given two identical JSON byte slices, assert pass; given two differing slices, assert fail with diff output
Test that expected-graph.json files are valid JSON and conform to the code_graph.proto schema
CI job extracts go-cycles fixture and compares output byte-for-byte to bas/fixtures/go-cycles/expected-graph.json; fails on any difference
CI job extracts go-mislocated fixture and compares output byte-for-byte to bas/fixtures/go-mislocated/expected-graph.json; fails on any difference
CI determinism test: extract each fixture twice in the same run; assert both outputs are byte-for-byte identical to each other and to expected-graph.json
Clean-clone test: git clone the repository, run extraction, verify output matches committed expected-graph.json without any local state
CI build status is RED if any fixture graph diverges from its expected-graph.json; no soft-fail or warning-only mode
Fixture expected-graph.json files are version-controlled and reviewed as part of any extraction logic change
Downstream consumers (cartographer) can trust that a passing CI means extraction behavior is unchanged

title: Golden-Fixture Determinism Gate
